subject: general
question: If a certain sum at compound interest becomes 21over2 times in 5 years, then in how many years will it become 61over4 times, at the same rate of interest p.a.?
solution:
**Given:**

If a certain sum at compound interest becomes 21over2 times in 5 years

**Formula used:**

A = P(1 + R/100)T

**Calculation:**

In first case

A = (5/2)P

R = r%

A = P(1 + R/100)T

⇒ 5/2P = P(1 + R/100)⁵

⇒ 5/2 = (1 + R/100)⁵ ......(1)

In second case

Let, sum becomes 25/4 times in the times n years

A = (25/4)P

Time = n years

⇒ 25/4 = (1 + R/100)ⁿ

⇒ (5/2)² = (1 + R/100)ⁿ ....(2)

Using equation (1) and (2), we get

⇒ [(1 + R/100)⁵]² = (1 + R/100)ⁿ

⇒ (1 + R/100)¹⁰ = (1 + R/100)ⁿ

⇒ n = 10 years

**∴ The required time is 10 years**
